# S3. Epidemic phase

The epidemic phase of each forecast was defined from the change in the final evaluation data over the 28-day forecast period, for hospital admissions by location and for wastewater by site (see Methods).

Figure S5. Epidemic phase by forecast date for each location. Top panel: hospital admissions (7-day rolling sum) from the final evaluation dataset, with each forecast date to 7 days later shaded by the hospital admissions phase over the following 28 days. Bottom panels: log wastewater concentrations at each site, shaded by that site's phase.

# S6. Model-based evaluation

Figure S9. Scatterplots of the relative WIS against each covariate in the model (state population, number of sites, population coverage, average sampling frequency, minimum latency, variability in wastewater data and forecast date). Each point is a location-forecast date, with the relative WIS computed from the WIS averaged across horizons, shown on a log scale. Points are coloured by epidemic phase, with a smoothed trend.
